observations: Bare engine block shown from two close-up angles, no vehicle or chassis visible.
Ignition coils, valve cover, alternator, belt/pulley assembly, and oil cap visible.
Watermark text 'EMMY GOLD AUTO SPARE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlay both photos - this is the seller's shop branding, not an engine marking.
No manufacturer logo, engine code sticker, or stamped plate is legible in either photo.
No wiring harness, intake manifold, turbo, or sensors shown beyond what is mounted directly on the block.
Engine is sitting on a floor/shelf setup typical of a spare-parts yard, not on a stand or test rig.

claims.evidence: No Hyundai or Kia logo, engine code sticker, or stamped ID plate is visible in photo 0 or photo 1; cylinder count (4) is plausible from the coil pack layout but not confirmed by any readable marking.

risks.risk: Exact engine code/model unknown, which drives Hyundai/Kia engine value (e.g. G4FC vs G4NA vs Theta II differ greatly in price)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped engine code on the block (usually near the bellhousing or on a machined pad) or the casting number
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic 4-cyl used engine, lowest tier of the Hyundai/Kia range

risks.risk: Running condition unverified - could have internal damage (knocking, low compression, seized parts) not visible externally
risks.proof: Video of the engine running/starting on a test stand with audio, or a compression test readout

risks.risk: Completeness unclear - turbo, intake manifold, sensors, wiring loom, ECU may or may not be included
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photo set showing intake side, exhaust manifold side, and underside/oil pan
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block only, accessories not included

risks.risk: Mileage/origin (tokunbo import vs locally used) unverifiable, affects wear expectation
risks.proof: Photo of any import sticker, auction sheet, or odometer tag if available

risks.risk: Oil/coolant contamination or leaks (head gasket, oil pan) not visible from these angles
risks.proof: Photo of underside and oil fill area closely, plus a dipstick oil color check

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the stamped engine code / casting number on the block
Video of the engine cranking or running with audible sound
Photos of the intake side, exhaust side, and underside of the engine for completeness check
Any import/auction sticker or paperwork showing mileage or origin
response.reason: The brand/model claim that would set the price tier cannot be read from either photo, and no engine code or ID plate is visible, so even a worst-case price bucket for the specific Hyundai/Kia engine family cannot be assigned without that shot.
